@concat('"SELECT  
 rcpt_input_sbsb_id,
 rcpt_input_bgbg_id,
 RCPT_CREATE_DTM,
 RCPT_MCTR_RSN,
 CASE WHEN RCPT_INPUT_SBSB_ID <> '' '' THEN RCPT_INPUT_GRGR_ID 
      ELSE ''99999999'' 
      END RCPT_GRGR_ID,RCPT_AMT as RCPT_AMT
,NVL(BGBG_ID,''ALL'') AS CONTRACT_CODE
 FROM  CMC_RCPT_RECEIPTS RCPT
LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT SBSB_ID, MEME_CK, BGBG_ID
                            FROM CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
                            INNER JOIN CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME
                                ON SBSB_CK = SBSB_CK
                            INNER JOIN (SELECT MEME_CK, MAX(MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT) MAXEFFDT
                                               FROM CMC_MEMD_MECR_DETL MEMD
                                               INNER JOIN CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR
                                               ON GRGR_CK = GRGR_CK
                                               WHERE MEMD_EVENT_CD = ''SCCC'' 
                                               AND GRGR_ID IN (''MEMCRWP0'',''MOMCRWP0'',''TXMCR000'',''AZMCR000'',''NYMCRWP0'')
                                               GROUP BY MEME_CK
                                               ) MAXMEMD
                                ON MEME_CK = MEME_CK
                            INNER JOIN CMC_MEMD_MECR_DETL MEMD
                                ON MEME_CK = MEME_CK
                                AND MAXEFFDT = MEMD_HCFA_EFF_DT
                                AND MEMD_EVENT_CD = ''SCCC''
                            INNER JOIN CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG
                                ON BGBG_CK = BGBG_CK  
                            ) MEMD_BGBG                
         ON SBSB_ID = RCPT_INPUT_SBSB_ID
AND ((RCPT_INPUT_GRGR_ID = ''MEMCRWP0'' AND BGBG_ID IN (''H9065'',''H9219''))
OR (RCPT_INPUT_GRGR_ID = ''MOMCRWP0'' AND BGBG_ID = ''H6316'')
OR (RCPT_INPUT_GRGR_ID = ''TXMCR000'' AND BGBG_ID IN (''H8343'',''H8849''))
OR (RCPT_INPUT_GRGR_ID = ''AZMCR000'' AND BGBG_ID = ''H1423'')
OR (RCPT_INPUT_GRGR_ID = ''NYMCRWP0'' AND BGBG_ID = ''H1732''))
WHERE TRUNC(RCPT_CREATE_DTM) = TO_DATE(''"', variables('gv_CurrentDate'), '"'' ,''mm/dd/yyyy'')
AND RCPT_MCTR_RSN IN (''EBOX'',''MGR'')"')

UPDATE Receipts.EBOXPostbackHistory
SET [BatchID] = (SELECT MAX(BATCHID) FROM Receipts.EBoxBatch where BATCHDATE = @gv_CurrentDate)
WHERE IS_PROCESSED=0  

UPDATE Receipts.EBOXPostbackHistory
set [IS_PROCESSED] = CASE WHEN BatchID IS NOT NULL THEN '1' ELSE '0' END
